summary.result: The correlations between rural amenities were analyzed objectively using IIMT with the results satisfying the basic conditions of interactional information suggested in this research.
summary.background: Defining the correlations between rural amenities, while difficult, is important for the adequate and efficient development of these amenities.
summary.method: In this research, an Interactional Information Measuring Technique(IIMT) using Information Gathering and Utilizing System(IGUS) was developed to objectively analyze the correlations between abstract ideas.
